finish_summary: - bulk_discount_percent returns 5% for quantity 50 but spec requires 10%. - parse_coupon does not strip whitespace or ignore case, causing ValueError for valid coupons. - Cart.subtotal applies incorrect bulk discount for quantity 50 (expected 90% discount giving 950, actual 900). - Cart.total includes shipping fee even when subtotal is below threshold (expects free when subtotal <=3, but gets 60 fee).
